name: 진박새
title: Coal Tit — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Black cap and throat, large cream cheeks, distinct white nape patch, grey back, buff underside, two pale wing bars; short pointed bill.

name: 곤줄박이
title: Varied Tit — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Black cap and bib, cream face, rich orange-rust breast and belly, blue-grey back and wings, small orange patch on rear crown; NOT green-backed tit.

name: 어치
title: Eurasian Jay — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Warm pink-brown body, pale streaked crown, black moustache, brilliant blue-and-black barred wing panel, black tail, white rump.

name: 흰배지빠귀
title: Pale Thrush — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult male grey-brown head, olive-brown back, white belly, pale orange flanks, pale yellow bill with darker tip; discreet pale eyebrow, long thrush legs.

name: 호랑지빠귀
title: White's Thrush — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Golden olive-brown upperparts and cream underside covered in bold dark scalloped scales, robust thrush build, small pale eye ring; dark scallops distinguish from plain thrush.

name: 쇠딱따구리
title: Japanese Pygmy Woodpecker — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Tiny brown-grey woodpecker, white cheek stripes and pale underside streaks, black-white barred folded wings and back, stiff pointed tail; no large red crown.

name: 나무발발이
title: Eurasian Treecreeper — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Mottled warm brown back, cream white belly, strong pale eyebrow, thin curved-down bill, long stiff brown tail; near-upright tree-climbing posture with hooked toes but no branch.

name: 쏙독새
title: Grey Nightjar — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Low horizontal resting pose, intricately mottled grey-brown-tan plumage, flattened broad head, tiny short bill and large dark eye, long closed wings and tail, small feet.

name: 솔부엉이
title: Brown Boobook — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Brown Boobook adult: round head WITHOUT ear tufts, bright yellow forward-facing eyes, brown head and back, cream underside with bold vertical brown streaks, long hawk-like tail.

name: 히말라야직박구리
title: Himalayan Bulbul — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Tall pointed swept-back black crest, black throat and face, prominent white cheek, grey-brown body, long dark tail, small yellow undertail vent.

name: 파랑지빠귀
title: Blue Whistling Thrush — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Deep indigo blue adult bird, fine bright azure speckles on head and chest, glossy blue wings and tail, robust yellow bill, long dark legs.

name: 흰머리딱새
title: White-capped Redstart — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: ADULT MALE: bright white crown cap, black head throat and upper back, vivid orange-red belly rump and tail, dark wings; actual photo may show female but sprite is white-capped adult male.

name: 부채꼬리바위딱새
title: Plumbeous Water Redstart — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult male uniform slate-blue grey head and body, small black bill, contrasting vivid rusty-orange tail, dark wings, no white cap.

name: 붉은배시비아
title: Rufous Sibia — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Black cap, cinnamon rufous neck body and belly, grey-brown back, black-and-blue-grey wing panel, long layered tail with pale tips, slim straight dark bill.

name: 초록등박새
title: Green-backed Tit — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Black crown and bib, large white cheeks, olive GREEN back, yellow belly with black centre stripe, blue-grey wings with pale bars.

name: 붉은부리까마귀
title: Red-billed Chough — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Glossy black crow with slender curved bright RED bill and red legs, blue-black wing sheen, longish dark tail; no yellow bill.

name: 히말라야오색딱따구리
title: Himalayan Woodpecker — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Black-and-white pied woodpecker, large white cheek and shoulder patches, white barred dark wings, pale underside, red undertail, ADULT MALE small red nape.

name: 회색등때까치
title: Grey-backed Shrike — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Slate grey crown and back, bold black eye mask, white throat, orange-buff flanks, black wings with small white patch, long black tail, stout hooked black bill; NO chef clothes.

name: 사막딱새
title: Isabelline Wheatear — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Sandy buff plain head and back, pale cream breast, slight buff eyebrow, fine dark lores, black legs; black tail tip with white tail base and rump, upright open-country songbird.

name: 후투티
title: Common Hoopoe — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Warm buff-orange body, long thin downcurved black bill, fan-shaped erect orange crest with black tips, bold black-and-white wing and tail bars.

name: 파랑새
title: European Roller — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: European Roller Coracias garrulus, sky turquoise blue head and underside, rich chestnut-brown BACK, blue folded wings and tail, thick straight black bill. NOT Dollarbird.

name: 금눈쇠올빼미
title: Little Owl — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Small squat owl, round flat-topped head no ear tufts, bright yellow eyes, thick pale eyebrows, brown-white spotted head and back, cream belly with brown streaks, short tail.

name: 초원수리
title: Steppe Eagle — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Large dark-brown eagle perched standing, strong hooked dark bill with yellow cere and distinctive long yellow gape line toward eye, feathered thighs, yellow feet with black talons, broad folded wings.

name: 붉은꼬리때까치
title: Red-tailed Shrike — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult male warm brown cap and back, bold black mask, cream-white throat and belly, narrow white eyebrow, reddish-orange rump and long red-brown tail, black hooked bill; no clothes.

name: 사막때까치
title: Isabelline Shrike — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult male pale sand-grey brown crown and back, black eye mask, warm buff pale breast, rusty orange tail, small pale wing patch, black hooked bill; no clothes.

name: 유럽울새
title: European Robin — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Small round bird, bright orange face throat and upper chest, grey border to orange, olive-brown back, pale cream belly, thin dark bill and slender legs.

name: Common Blackbird
title: Common Blackbird — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: ADULT MALE all deep black plumage, bright yellow-orange bill and thin golden eye ring, long black tail, thrush proportions.

name: European Bee-eater
title: European Bee-eater — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Chestnut crown and mantle, bright yellow throat bordered black, turquoise blue-green belly, black eye stripe, green-blue folded wings, long slim curved black bill and two pointed central tail streamers.

name: Red-backed Shrike
title: Red-backed Shrike — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult male blue-grey crown nape, chestnut red-brown back, brown folded wings, strong black eye mask, pale pink-buff underside, black tail with white outer patches, stout hooked bill; guest without apron or tools.

name: Lesser Grey Shrike
title: Lesser Grey Shrike — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult male pale grey crown and back, broad black FOREHEAD band joined to eye mask, faint blush-pink underside, black wings with white patch, short stout black bill and dark tail.

name: European Nightjar
title: European Nightjar — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Low horizontal resting nightjar, intricately mottled warm grey brown plumage, buff neckline and pale scapular streaks, huge dark eye tiny bill, very long pointed closed wings and long tail, small feet.

name: Loggerhead Shrike
title: Loggerhead Shrike — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Pale grey crown and back, bold broad black mask extending above bill, white underside, black wings with white patch, black white-edged long tail, unusually stout short hooked bill, no clothes.

name: American Kestrel
title: American Kestrel — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult male blue-grey crown and wing coverts, rusty orange back with dark horizontal bars, cream-buff spotted belly, TWO dark vertical facial stripes, rust tail with dark terminal band, small hooked bill, yellow talons.

name: Eastern Bluebird
title: Eastern Bluebird — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult male brilliant cobalt blue head back wings and tail, warm red-orange throat and breast, white belly, slender black bill.

name: American Robin
title: American Robin — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult dark grey back, blackish head with broken white eye ring, rusty orange breast and belly, yellow bill and dark tip, pale throat with dark streaks, black tail, long thrush legs.

name: Belted Kingfisher
title: Belted Kingfisher — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult MALE slate-blue head and back, spiky shaggy crest, white neck collar and belly with ONE broad blue chest belt, long stout black straight bill. No rusty female belly band.

name: Northern Mockingbird
title: Northern Mockingbird — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Plain light-grey head and back, cream white belly, dark folded wings with distinct white wing bars and panels, long dark tail with white outer feathers, slender slightly curved dark bill.

name: Lilac-breasted Roller
title: Lilac-breasted Roller — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Lilac-purple breast, pale green crown and blue-green back, rich turquoise belly, blue wings, tan face with dark eye stripe, black bill, two long pointed tail streamers.

name: African Grey Hornbill
title: African Grey Hornbill — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Grey head and neck, brown-grey upperparts, pale grey underside, long curved black bill with small low casque and pale cream stripe along upper mandible, long tail with white outer tips.

name: African Pygmy Kingfisher
title: African Pygmy Kingfisher — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Tiny kingfisher, brilliant blue crown and back, lilac-violet ear patch, rich orange face breast and belly, orange-red straight bill, short blue tail, tiny red-orange feet.

name: Northern Fiscal
title: Northern Fiscal — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult black head back and tail, white chest belly and shoulder wing stripe, black hooked bill, very long slim dark tail, black legs; northern fiscal black upperparts not grey-crowned shrike.

name: Mackinnon's Shrike
title: Mackinnon's Shrike — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult dark charcoal-black cap and back, white eyebrow and face stripes, black eye mask, white underside with reddish brown flank patch, dark tail with pale tips, black hooked bill.

name: Superb Starling
title: Superb Starling — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult iridescent metallic blue-green head back and wings, black crown and face, bright pale yellow-white eye, vivid orange belly separated from blue chest by thin white breast band, short dark bill.

name: Southern Fiscal
title: Southern Fiscal — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult black crown back tail, white cheek-neck sides and underside, prominent white shoulder patch/wing stripe, long black tail with white outer edge, black hooked bill and legs; no grey crown.

name: Cape Wagtail
title: Cape Wagtail — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Grey-olive brown head and back, pale eyebrow, dark throat bib on cream belly, grey folded wings with light edges, long grey-black tail edged white, slim dark bill and long dark legs.

name: Cape Robin-Chat
title: Cape Robin-Chat — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Grey back and head, bold white eyebrow above dark face mask, rich orange throat breast and tail, pale greyish-white lower belly, thin dark bill.

name: Fiscal Flycatcher
title: Fiscal Flycatcher — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: ADULT MALE black head back wings and tail, white belly and sides of neck, large white wing patch, slender flycatcher bill NOT bulky shrike hook, small upright body.

name: Cape Crow
title: Cape Crow — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Entire glossy black crow, notably long slender straight black bill, black feet, robust body and longish dark tail, subtle blue sheen.

name: Karoo Scrub-Robin
title: Karoo Scrub Robin — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Plain grey-brown head and back, pale cream-grey underside, whitish eyebrow and dark eye line, long brown tail with light outer tips, slim dark bill, ground-loving robin proportions.

name: São Tomé Fiscal
title: Sao Tome Fiscal — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Adult glossy black head back wings and long tail, pale straw-YELLOW belly and breast, strong black hooked bill, grey legs; no big white wing patch, island forest shrike.

name: São Tomé Thrush
title: Sao Tome Thrush — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Olive-brown head and upperparts, buff yellowish underside with fine dark spots and streaks on upper chest, brown tail, yellow-orange bill and pale eye ring, sturdy thrush legs.

name: São Tomé Oriole
title: Sao Tome Oriole — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: ADULT black head neck wings and tail, olive-yellow mantle and body, pale golden-cream breast, thick coral-pink bill, red eye, pale cream wing edging.

name: Madagascar Kingfisher
title: Malagasy Kingfisher — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: Malagasy Kingfisher: deep azure crown and back, fine turquoise crown speckles, orange-rufous face and underside, pale throat, long straight black bill, short blue tail, tiny orange-red feet.

name: Madagascar Kestrel
title: Malagasy Kestrel — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: ADULT MALE grey head, rusty brown black-spotted back, pale cream speckled chest and belly, grey tail with wide black tip, dark moustache, yellow cere and feet, small black hooked bill, folded wings.

name: Madagascar Magpie-Robin
title: Madagascar Magpie-Robin — BirdNET+ Taxonomy
features: ADULT MALE nominate Madagascar Magpie-Robin: black glossy head back throat and upper breast, white belly and white wing patch, long dark tail, slender black bill. Not all-black subspecies.
